name: kb-writer
description: Create KB Writer intent workspaces from completed local sessions, with PM-reviewed completion envelopes. Bundles the PM Toolkit skill pack (pm-prd, pm-ask-code, pm-critic-check, pm-feasibility-check, pm-competitive-analysis, pm-data-tracking, pm-feature-control-advisor, testit-features) as vendored skills.

interface.shortDescription: Turn a finished local session into a reviewed KB intent workspace.
interface.longDescription: KB Writer reduces a completed local coding session into a PM-reviewed completion envelope, creates a durable intent workspace, and lets the PM drive planning, target selection, drafting, review, and publication through the KB Writer backend. This package also vendors the PM Toolkit skill pack so PMs can run PRD, feasibility, critic, competitive-analysis, data-tracking, feature-control, codebase Q&A, and TestIt workflows from the same plugin.
interface.defaultPrompt: Create a KB intent from this session.
